company.name: Peoplebox.ai
company.shortDescription: Turn Employees Feedback into Real Actions using smart action lists, nudges & byte size learnings
company.description:
Peoplebox.ai (formerly Culturegrade)  is an AI powered one stop tool for employee engagement, continous performance and manager success. It helps HR with deep engagement Insights, action items through automated engagement surveys and a platform to communicate anonymously with employee on their feedback. 

It also empowers managers to build high performing teams through continuous feedback & powerful 1:1s. Most importantly, it uses Nova, an AI Coach for Managers to help them convert employees feedback into actions through smart prioritization, nudges and byte size learning.

We are ex-YC and IIT founders working on a simple mission to build great managers and engaged teams using technology, transparency and behaviour science. We are a Nexus funded company with offices in San Francisco & Bangalore.
